questions.question: The shorter side of a rectangle is 21 cm less than the longer side. The numerical value of its area is equal to 5 times the numerical value of its perimeter. What is the length (in cm) of its longer side?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **longer side** be **L** and the **shorter side** be **L − 21**.

Given: **Area = 5 × Perimeter**

L(L − 21) = 5 × 2(L + L − 21) ⇒ L² − 21L = 10(2L − 21)

L² − 21L = 20L − 210 ⇒ L² − 41L + 210 = 0

By factoring: (L − 35)(L − 6) = 0. Since L > 21, **L = 35**.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let **longer side (l)** = x cm

Then **shorter side (b)** = (x − 21) cm

**Formula Used:**

**Area of Rectangle** = l × b

**Perimeter of Rectangle** = 2(l + b)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c4df2c2d2e5a9057759fa4710ecb25d7ecf3f9bd6e6e215ed4c7ee729750341.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 5 × Perimeter

⇒ x(x − 21) = 5 × [2(x + x − 21)]

⇒ x² − 21x = 10(2x − 21)

⇒ x² − 21x = 20x − 210

⇒ x² − 41x + 210 = 0

⇒ x² − 35x − 6x + 210 = 0

⇒ x(x − 35) − 6(x − 35) = 0

⇒ (x − 35)(x − 6) = 0

⇒ x = 35 or x = 6

⇒ Since b = x − 21, x must be greater than 21. ∴ x = 35.

**∴ The correct answer is 35 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral with four right angles. Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Diagonal length = √(l² + b²).

Quadratic Roots

For x² − (Sum of roots)x + (Product of roots) = 0, the roots are found by splitting the middle term or using the formula.

Area and Perimeter Relations

The numerical equality of area and perimeter (or their multiples) is a common geometric problem solved using algebraic equations.</p

questions.question: Which is the largest inland saline wetland in India?

• The lake is fed by several rivers, including the **Mendha, Rupangarh, Khari, and Khandela** rivers.
 
• It is recognized as a **Ramsar site**, which designates it as a wetland of international importance.

• It plays a crucial role in maintaining the **hydrological balance** of the region.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 81?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by **81** if the **sum of its digits** is divisible by **81** (for very large numbers) or if it is a multiple of 81.

More simply, any number divisible by 81 must also be divisible by **9** (Sum of digits must be a multiple of 9).

Check sum of digits for 5265: 5 + 2 + 6 + 5 = 18. Since 18 is divisible by 9, check 5265 ÷ 81.

5265 ÷ 81 = 65.

**∴ The correct answer is 5265.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers (1) 5232, (2) 5854, (3) 5265, (4) 4678.

**Formula Used:** Divisibility rule of 81. A number is divisible by 81 if the quotient is an integer when divided by 81.

⇒ Option 1: 5232 ÷ 81 ≈ 64.59 (Not divisible)

⇒ Option 2: 5854 ÷ 81 ≈ 72.27 (Not divisible)

⇒ Option 3: 5265 ÷ 81 = 65 (Exactly divisible)

⇒ Option 4: 4678 ÷ 81 ≈ 57.75 (Not divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 5265.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the **sum of its digits** is divisible by 9.

Divisibility by 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is divisible by 3.

Composite Divisibility

If a number is divisible by **nx**, it must also be divisible by **n**. Here, 81 = 3⁴ = 9², so it must be divisible by 3 and 9.</p

questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct with reference to the modern periodic table?

options.text: ​Lanthanoids and actinoids are placed in separate panels at the bottom.
Groups are the vertical columns, and periods are horizontal rows.
The second and third periods each contain 8 elements.

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**The first period contains 8 elements.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **modern periodic table** arranges elements based on their **atomic numbers** in horizontal rows called **periods** and vertical columns called **groups.**
 
• The **first period** of the modern periodic table contains only **two elements: Hydrogen and Helium.**
 
• This is because the first energy level (shell) can hold a maximum of **two electrons.**
 
• Thus, the statement that the first period contains **8 elements** is incorrect.
 
• Subsequent periods contain more elements due to the increasing capacity of energy levels to hold electrons.
 
• For example, the **second period** contains **8 elements**, corresponding to the filling of the 2s and 2p orbitals.
 
• The periodic table is divided into blocks based on the **sub-shells** being filled (s, p, d, f blocks).
 
• The placement of elements reflects their **properties** and provides a systematic way to study chemical behavior.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lanthanoids and actinoids are placed in separate panels at the bottom**__

 __
 
• **Lanthanoids** and **actinoids** are the f-block elements of the periodic table.
 
• They are placed separately to maintain the **structure and readability** of the table.
 
• **Lanthanoids** are elements with atomic numbers 57 to 71, while **actinoids** are elements with atomic numbers 89 to 103.
 
• These elements exhibit **unique electronic configurations** and properties, such as their use in **magnets, lasers, and nuclear reactors.**
 
 
 
• **Groups are the vertical columns, and periods are horizontal rows**__
 __
 
• The modern periodic table has **18 groups** and **7 periods.**
 
• **Groups** are vertical columns where elements have similar **valence electron configurations** and chemical properties.
 
• **Periods** are horizontal rows representing elements with increasing atomic numbers.
 
• For example, elements in Group 1 are the **alkali metals,** while those in Group 17 are the **halogens.**
 
 
 
• **The second and third periods each contain 8 elements**__
 
 
• The **second period** contains elements from **Lithium to Neon**, corresponding to the filling of 2s and 2p orbitals.
 
• The **third period** contains elements from **Sodium to Argon**, corresponding to the filling of 3s and 3p orbitals.
 
• This pattern reflects the **quantum mechanical arrangement of electrons** in atoms.

questions.question: An electric pump can fill a tank in 6 hours. Due to a leakage in the tank, it takes 7½ hours to fill the tank. How much time will this leak take to empty the full tank if water does not get in or out of the tank through any other point during this period?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Time taken by **Pump** (A) = 6 hours

Time taken by **Pump + Leak** (A + B) = 7.5 hours

Emptying time for **Leak** = (XY) ÷ (Y − X)

⇒ (6 × 7.5) ÷ (7.5 − 6) = 45 ÷ 1.5 = 30 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 30 hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Filling time = 6 hr, Filling with leak = 7.5 (15/2) hr.

**Formula Used:** Total Work = LCM of time; Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

 
 **Person/Pipe** **Time (hr)** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 Pump (A) 6 30 5 
 Pump + Leak (A+B) 15/2 4 

⇒ Efficiency of **Pump** (A) = 5 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of **Pump + Leak** (A + B) = 4 units/hr

⇒ Efficiency of **Leak** (B) = 4 − 5 = −1 unit/hr (negative sign denotes emptying)

⇒ Time taken by **Leak** to empty the tank = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of B

⇒ 30 ÷ 1 = 30 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 30 hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Concept

Efficiency of an **inlet pipe** is taken as positive, while the efficiency of an **outlet pipe (leak)** is taken as negative.

Net Efficiency

If two pipes A and B work together, net efficiency = Efficiency of A + Efficiency of B. Total time = Total Work ÷ Net Efficiency.

Work-Time Relation

Time taken to complete a task is **inversely proportional** to the efficiency of the worker or pipe.</p

**∴ The correct answer is 70% loss.**

questions.question: Kalpana and Sudha got 621 and 522 marks, respectively, in the same examination. If Kalpana scored 69% marks, then what is the percentage of marks scored by Sudha?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare marks directly with percentages since the **Maximum Marks** are the same.

621 marks → 69%

1 mark → 69 ÷ 621 %

522 marks → (69 ÷ 621) × 522 %

522 marks → (1 ÷ 9) × 522 = 58%

**∴ The correct answer is 58%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marks of **Kalpana** = 621, Percentage of **Kalpana** = 69%, Marks of **Sudha** = 522.

**Formula Used:** Maximum Marks = (Obtained Marks ÷ Percentage) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50c637f26e33c25eb20779c8d80004bcef168a25663e6c76dadad39232bd33a0.png] 

⇒ Let the **Maximum Marks** be M.

⇒ 69% of M = 621

⇒ (69 ÷ 100) × M = 621

⇒ M = (621 × 100) ÷ 69 = 900

⇒ **Sudha's Percentage** = (Marks Scored ÷ Maximum Marks) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (522 ÷ 900) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 522 ÷ 9 = 58%

**∴ The correct answer is 58%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

questions.question: A woman travelled at a speed of 20 m/min for 80 min, and at a speed of 65 m/min for 64 min. Her average speed (in m/min) is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **time** = 80 : 64 = 5 : 4

**Weighted Average Speed** = [(Speed₁ × Time Ratio₁) + (Speed₂ × Time Ratio₂)] ÷ Total Ratio

Average Speed = [(20 × 5) + (65 × 4)] ÷ (5 + 4)

Average Speed = [100 + 260] ÷ 9 = 360 ÷ 9 = 40 m/min

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m/min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed₁ = 20 m/min, Time₁ = 80 min

Speed₂ = 65 m/min, Time₂ = 64 min

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Distance = Speed × Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac14c49a268f314f1ded47c51728c87a1c8b38aa73ca96197dc11e6a8cad740f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance₁ = 20 × 80 = 1600 m

⇒ Distance₂ = 65 × 64 = 4160 m

⇒ Total Distance = 1600 + 4160 = 5760 m

⇒ Total Time = 80 + 64 = 144 min

⇒ Average Speed = 5760 ÷ 144

⇒ Average Speed = 40 m/min

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m/min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

When two equal distances are covered at speeds u and v, Average Speed = (2 × u × v) ÷ (u + v).

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the same direction, relative speed is |u − v|. In opposite directions, it is (u + v).

Unit Conversion

To convert kmph to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to kmph, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: If a sum of ₹6,70,000 is invested for a year at 2% per annum compounded half yearly, then find the compound interest.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For **half-yearly compounding**, the **Rate** is halved and **Time** is doubled.

New Rate = 2% ÷ 2 = 1% per half-year | Periods (n) = 1 × 2 = 2

**Effective Rate** for 2 periods = x + y + (xy/100) ⇒ 1 + 1 + (1 × 1)/100 = 2.01%

**Compound Interest** = 2.01% of ₹6,70,000 ⇒ 6,70,000 × 0.0201 = ₹13,467

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,467.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Principal (P)** = ₹6,70,000, **Annual Rate (R)** = 2%, **Time (T)** = 1 year.

**Formula Used:** Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ and CI = A − P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e20e97fb9126d29155381c64aec770787f7219cd211d89d8c0f1bed726bd31f.png] 

⇒ Half-yearly rate (r) = 2% ÷ 2 = 1%

⇒ Number of half-years (n) = 1 × 2 = 2

⇒ A = 6,70,000 × (1 + 1/100)²

⇒ A = 6,70,000 × (1.01)²

⇒ A = 6,70,000 × 1.0201 = ₹6,83,467

⇒ CI = 6,83,467 − 6,70,000

⇒ CI = ₹13,467

**∴ The correct answer is ₹13,467.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Half-Yearly Compounding Rule

When interest is **compounded half-yearly**, the annual rate R becomes R/2 and the time T becomes 2T.

Effective Rate Formula

For two periods with rate r%, the effective percentage rate is calculated as [r + r + (r×r)/100] %.

CI vs SI for 2 Years

The difference between **Compound Interest** and **Simple Interest** for 2 years is P(R/100)².

questions.question: A and B complete a work in 15 days. If A alone can do it in 17 days, then B alone can do two-third of the same work in _______ days.
questions.solution:

Combined efficiency of **A + B** = 1/15

Efficiency of **A** = 1/17

Efficiency of **B** = 1/15 − 1/17 = 2/255

Time for **B** to do 2/3 work = (2/3) ÷ (2/255) = (2/3) × (255/2) = 85 days

**∴ The correct answer is 85 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by (A+B) = 15 days, Time taken by A = 17 days.

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = Efficiency of (A+B) − Efficiency of A

⇒ Efficiency of **B** = 17 − 15 = 2 units/day

⇒ Time taken by **B** alone = 170 ÷ 2 = 85 days

**∴ The correct answer is 85 days.**

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken to complete a task. Efficiency = Work ÷ Time.

questions.question: Find the roots of x ⁻⁴ - 10x⁻² + 9 = 0
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Treat the equation as a **quadratic** in terms of **x−²**.

The factors for the quadratic **y² − 10y + 9 = 0** are **9** and **1** (since 9 × 1 = 9 and 9 + 1 = 10).

Set **x−² = 9** ⇒ **x² = 1/9** ⇒ **x = ± 1/3**.

Set **x−² = 1** ⇒ **x² = 1** ⇒ **x = ± 1**.

**∴ The correct answer is ± 1, ± 1/3.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The equation is x−⁴ − 10x−² + 9 = 0.

**Formula Used:**

For an equation of the form **ax²ⁿ + bxⁿ + c = 0**, we use **substitution** (t = xⁿ) to solve it as a quadratic.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let **t = x−²**. Then, x−⁴ = (x−²)² = **t²**.

⇒ substituting these in the original equation: t² − 10t + 9 = 0

⇒ t² − 9t − t + 9 = 0

⇒ t(t − 9) − 1(t − 9) = 0

⇒ (t − 9)(t − 1) = 0

⇒ t = 9 or t = 1

⇒ When t = 9: x−² = 9 ⇒ 1/x² = 9 ⇒ x² = 1/9 ⇒ **x = ± 1/3**

⇒ When t = 1: x−² = 1 ⇒ 1/x² = 1 ⇒ x² = 1 ⇒ **x = ± 1**

Combining the results, the roots are ± 1 and ± 1/3.

**∴ The correct answer is ± 1, ± 1/3.**

**__Additional Information__**

Substitution in Higher-Degree Equations

Equations like ax⁴ + bx² + c = 0 or ax−⁴ + bx−² + c = 0 are called **equations reducible to quadratic form**. They are solved by replacing the middle variable term with a single letter.

Discriminant Rule

The number of real roots depends on the **discriminant (D = b² − 4ac)**. In this case, D = (−10)² − 4(1)(9) = 100 − 36 = 64, which is a **perfect square**, leading to rational roots for t.

Negative Exponents Property

Always remember that **x−ⁿ = 1/xⁿ**. When solving for x after finding t, ensure to take the **reciprocal** before calculating the square root.</p

questions.question: If a + b = 24 and (a - b) ² = 268 find the value of product of a and b.

Use the direct **algebraic identity**: 4ab = (a + b)² − (a − b)².

Substitute the given values: 4ab = (24)² − 268.

ab = 308 ÷ 4 = 77.

**∴ The correct answer is 77.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers (a + b) = 24

Square of the difference (a − b)² = 268

**Formula Used:**

Standard expansion of **binomial squares**: (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab and (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab.

**Calculations:**

⇒ (a + b)² = 24² = 576

⇒ a² + b² + 2ab = 576 --- (Equation 1)

⇒ a² + b² − 2ab = 268 --- (Equation 2)

Subtracting Equation 2 from Equation 1:

⇒ (a² + b² + 2ab) − (a² + b² − 2ab) = 576 − 268

⇒ 4ab = 308

⇒ ab = 308 ÷ 4

⇒ ab = 77

The product of **a and b** is found to be 77, which matches **Option (2)**.

**∴ The correct answer is 77.**

**__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Algebraic Identities

The relation between the sum and difference squares is: (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab.

Sum of Squares Identity

Another useful identity is the sum of squares: (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²).

Difference of Squares

The difference of two squares is factored as: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).</p

questions.question: With reference to computer systems, what does CPU stand for?

__
 
• The **Central Processing Unit (CPU)** is often referred to as the **"brain of the computer"**.
 
• It is responsible for performing **arithmetic, logic, control, and input/output operations** as specified by the instructions in a program.
 
• The CPU comprises three key components:
 
 
• **Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU):** Performs arithmetic and logical operations.
 
• **Control Unit (CU):** Directs the operations of the processor and coordinates with other computer components.
 
• **Registers:** Small storage units within the CPU used for quick data access.
 
 
 
• It processes data received from **input devices** and sends the output to **output devices**.
 
• The CPU interacts with the **memory unit** (RAM) to fetch, decode, and execute instructions.
 
• Modern CPUs are designed with **multiple cores**, allowing them to process multiple tasks simultaneously, improving performance.
 
• Examples of CPUs include processors from companies like **Intel (e.g., Core i5, i7)** and **AMD (e.g., Ryzen 5, Ryzen 7)**.
 
• The performance of a CPU is measured in terms of its **clock speed** (e.g., GHz) and the number of **cores**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Computer Processing Utility**__

 __
 
• This term is incorrect as there is no such established term in computer science.
 
• The word "Utility" generally refers to software tools used for system maintenance or performance enhancement, not a hardware component like the CPU.
 
 
 
• **Central Programming Unit**__
 __
 
• This is an incorrect term. The CPU does not specifically deal with programming but rather the execution of instructions from programs.
 
• Programming is typically done using software tools like compilers, interpreters, or IDEs, not the CPU directly.
 
 
 
• **Control Processing Unit**__
 
 
• This term is incorrect. While the CPU includes a **Control Unit (CU)**, the entire unit is not referred to as the "Control Processing Unit."
 
• The Control Unit is just one of the components of the CPU, alongside the **ALU** and **Registers**.

questions.question: The average of 10 observations is 40. It was realised later that an observation was misread as 32 in place of 43. Find the correct average.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net change in **Sum** = **Correct value** − **Wrong value** = 43 − 32 = +11

Change in **Average** = Net change in Sum ÷ Total observations = 11 ÷ 10 = +1.1

**Correct Average** = Old Average + Change in Average = 40 + 1.1 = 41.1

**∴ The correct answer is 41.1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Total observations** (n) = 10 | **Old Average** = 40 | **Wrong value** = 32 | **Correct value** = 43

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a3f2ce428fbd3564c7194d2695b223332820bfc9514f5135ae9489205d353f9.png] 

**Formula:** **Correct Average** = (**Old Sum** − **Wrong Value** + **Correct Value**) ÷ n

⇒ **Old Sum** = Average × Number of observations = 40 × 10 = 400

⇒ **Correct Sum** = 400 − 32 + 43

⇒ **Correct Sum** = 411

⇒ **Correct Average** = 411 ÷ 10

⇒ **Correct Average** = 41.1

**∴ The correct answer is 41.1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

When two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes n₁ and n₂ are combined, the combined average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

Arithmetic Mean Property

If each observation is increased by a constant value 'k', the **new average** also increases by 'k'. If multiplied by 'k', the new average becomes **old average × k**.

Correction Formula

Correct Average = Old Average + (Sum of Correct items − Sum of Incorrect items) ÷ Total items.</p

⇒ a = 9

⇒ c = 4 × a = 4 × 9

⇒ c = 36

Mean Proportional

If a, b, c are in continued proportion, then b is called the mean proportional between a and c, where b = √(ac).

Third Proportional

In the proportion a : b :: b : c, c is known as the third proportional to a and b, calculated as c = b²/a.

questions.question: In finding the HCF of two numbers by division method, the quotients are 4, 5, and 9, respectively, and the last divisor is 18. What is the LCM of the two numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Working backwards using **successive quotients** 4, 5, 9 and **last divisor** 18:

Third divisor (HCF) = 18

Second divisor = 18 × 9 = 162

First divisor (Number 2) = 162 × 5 + 18 = 828

Dividend (Number 1) = 828 × 4 + 162 = 3474

LCM = (3474 × 828) ÷ 18 = 3474 × 46 = 159804

**∴ The correct answer is 159804.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Quotients = 4, 5, 9; Last divisor = 18.

**Formula Used:** Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder; LCM × HCF = Product of two numbers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2527f77343d586d2773e97827bd2f7c0102eca38fbd4af419addaff277108e94.png] 

⇒ **Step 3:** Last divisor is 18 and quotient is 9. Remainder is 0.

⇒ Divisor in Step 3 = 18 × 9 + 0 = 162. (This was the remainder of Step 2)

⇒ **Step 2:** Quotient is 5 and remainder is 18.

⇒ Divisor in Step 2 = 162 × 5 + 18 = 810 + 18 = 828. (This was the remainder of Step 1)

⇒ **Step 1:** Quotient is 4 and remainder is 162.

⇒ Dividend = 828 × 4 + 162 = 3312 + 162 = 3474.

⇒ Two numbers are 3474 and 828. HCF = 18.

⇒ LCM = (3474 × 828) ÷ 18 = 3474 × 46 = 159804.

**∴ The correct answer is 159804.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Long Division Method for HCF

Also known as the **Euclidean Algorithm**, where the divisor of the last step (where remainder is zero) is the HCF.

LCM and HCF Relationship

For any two numbers 'a' and 'b', Product of numbers = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

Properties of HCF

HCF is always a factor of the difference between the two numbers and also a factor of their LCM.</p

questions.question: What makes DNA the most abundant genetic material?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Its stable double-helical structure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **double-helical structure** of DNA is stabilized by hydrogen bonds between the nitrogenous bases and hydrophobic interactions among the base pairs.
 
• This stable structure ensures the **faithful replication** and preservation of genetic information across generations.
 
• The stability of DNA allows it to resist degradation and maintain its integrity, making it the most **abundant genetic material**.
 
• The backbone of DNA is made up of **phosphate and deoxyribose sugar**, which contributes to its chemical resilience.
 
• The structure also facilitates the precise pairing of bases (adenine with thymine, and cytosine with guanine), ensuring **accurate genetic coding**.
 
• The stability of DNA is further enhanced by its ability to interact with **histones and other proteins**, which help compact and protect it within chromosomes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Its high mutation rate**__

 __
 
• A high mutation rate would make DNA unstable and less reliable for preserving genetic information.
 
• While mutations play a role in evolution, excessive mutations can lead to **genetic disorders** and errors in replication.
 
 
 
• **Its interaction with proteins**__
 __
 
• DNA interacts with proteins like histones to form chromatin; however, this feature is not directly responsible for DNA being the most abundant genetic material.
 
• Protein interactions primarily help in **packaging and regulation** of genetic material.
 
 
 
• **Its enzymatic roles**__
 
 
• DNA itself does not perform enzymatic roles; instead, enzymes like DNA polymerase and helicase act on DNA during replication and repair.
 
• Enzymatic roles are more relevant to **RNA**, which can act as a ribozyme (catalytic RNA).

options.text: Ministers leave all work operations to be done by civil servants

__
 
• The **Union Council of Ministers** is the executive authority in India, responsible for the administration of the country under the guidance of the Prime Minister.
 
• Each minister is designated as the **political head of his/her ministry**, meaning they are responsible for setting policies, making decisions, and ensuring the implementation of laws within their respective departments.
 
• Ministers work in collaboration with **civil servants** who are tasked with operational execution, providing expertise, and implementing policies laid down by the government.
 
• The political leadership of ministers ensures that the actions of their ministry align with the government’s vision and objectives, as well as the interests of the public.
 
• This structure is derived from the **Westminster system**, where the ministers are accountable to the legislature and indirectly to the public.
 
• The Union Council of Ministers operates under the framework of the **Indian Constitution**, particularly Articles **74** and **75**, which define its composition, functions, and roles.

 __

• **Centralisation of power in local bodies**__
 __
 
• This is incorrect because the Union Council of Ministers is responsible for **national-level governance**, not local bodies. Local governance is handled by **Panchayati Raj Institutions** and urban municipal bodies under the provisions of the Constitution.

questions.question: In △ABC, DE ∥ AC, where D and E are the points on sides AB and BC, respectively.If BD = 12 cm and AD = 11 cm, then what is the ratio of the area of △BDE to that of the trapezium ADEC?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side ratio of **ΔBDE** to **ΔBAC** = BD : (BD + AD) = 12 : (12 + 11) = 12 : 23.

Area ratio of **ΔBDE** to **ΔBAC** = 12² : 23² = 144 : 529.

Area of **trapezium ADEC** = Area(ΔBAC) − Area(ΔBDE) = 529 − 144 = 385 units.

Required ratio = Area(ΔBDE) : Area(trapezium ADEC) = 144 : 385.

**∴ The correct answer is 144 : 385.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In **ΔABC**, **DE || AC**. **BD** = 12 cm and **AD** = 11 cm.

**Formula Used:**

If two triangles are **similar**, the ratio of their **areas** is equal to the **square** of the ratio of their **corresponding sides**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb3984156afea3706e6941d1f2ad403014c467054db8841c9f8f329090d00e75.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total length of side **AB** = **BD** + **AD**

⇒ **AB** = 12 + 11 = 23 cm

⇒ Since **DE || AC**, **ΔBDE ∼ ΔBAC** (by **AA similarity** criterion)

⇒ Area(ΔBDE) ÷ Area(ΔBAC) = (BD ÷ AB)²

⇒ Area(ΔBDE) ÷ Area(ΔBAC) = (12 ÷ 23)² = 144 ÷ 529

⇒ Let Area(ΔBDE) = 144 units and Area(ΔBAC) = 529 units

⇒ Area(trapezium ADEC) = Area(ΔBAC) − Area(ΔBDE)

⇒ Area(trapezium ADEC) = 529 − 144 = 385 units

⇒ Ratio = Area(ΔBDE) : Area(trapezium ADEC) = 144 : 385

**∴ The correct answer is 144 : 385.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem)

If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, it divides the other two sides in the same ratio: BD/AD = BE/EC.

Area of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of any two corresponding sides: Area1/Area2 = (s1/s2)².

AA Similarity Criterion

If two angles of one triangle are equal to two angles of another triangle, then the two triangles are similar.</p

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For an **odd number of terms**, the average is the **middle term** itself. For an **even number of terms**, the average is the mean of the **two middle terms**.

Difference Property

questions.question: A boat takes 39 minutes to go 27.9 km upstream. The ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to that of the stream is 9 : 4. How much total time (in hours) will the boat take to go 18.9 km upstream and 51.3 km downstream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Upstream speed (U) = 27.9 ÷ (39/60) = 42.92 kmph. Ratio speed: Water (x) = 9k, Stream (y) = 4k.

Upstream speed U = x − y = 5k. Downstream speed D = x + y = 13k.

Since 5k = 42.92, k = 8.584. U = 42.92, D = 13 × 8.584 = 111.592.

Time = (18.9 ÷ 42.92) + (51.3 ÷ 111.592) ≈ 0.44 + 0.46 = 0.9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.9 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a951b318b007e582667ccdb0158f941579b5d7872b36615ea0889f94ac7ea170.png] 

**Given:**

Distance upstream₁ = 27.9 km, Time₁ = 39 min = 39/60 hours.

Ratio of **Speed of Boat (x)** to **Speed of Stream (y)** = 9 : 4.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Upstream speed (U) = Distance / Time = 27.9 ÷ (39/60) = (27.9 × 60) ÷ 39 = 1674 ÷ 39 = 42.923 kmph.

⇒ Let x = 9k and y = 4k. Then U = x − y = 5k.

⇒ 5k = 42.923 ⇒ k = 8.5846.

⇒ Downstream speed (D) = x + y = 13k = 13 × 8.5846 = 111.6 kmph.

⇒ Time for 18.9 km upstream = 18.9 ÷ 42.923 ≈ 0.44 hours.

⇒ Time for 51.3 km downstream = 51.3 ÷ 111.6 ≈ 0.46 hours.

⇒ Total Time = 0.44 + 0.46 = 0.9 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.9 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed in Water

Upstream Speed (U) = x − y and Downstream Speed (D) = x + y, where x is boat speed in still water and y is stream speed.

Speed Components

Boat speed in still water x = (D + U) ÷ 2 and Stream speed y = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

Average Speed = (U × D) / x = (x² − y²) / x kmph.</p

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the Supreme Court's writ jurisdiction is correct?

__
 
• The Supreme Court’s **writ jurisdiction** is provided under **Article 32** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• It empowers the Supreme Court to issue writs for the enforcement of **Fundamental Rights**.
 
• Fundamental Rights are enshrined under **Part III** of the Indian Constitution, including rights such as **Right to Equality, Right to Freedom, Right against Exploitation, Right to Constitutional Remedies**, etc.
 
• The writ jurisdiction of the Supreme Court is considered a crucial mechanism for ensuring the protection of citizens' rights and maintaining the rule of law.
 
• The types of writs that can be issued include **Habeas Corpus, Mandamus, Prohibition, Certiorari, and Quo Warranto**.
 
• Article 32 is often referred to as the **"Heart and Soul of the Constitution"**, as described by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, due to its significant role in safeguarding Fundamental Rights.
 
• Unlike the High Courts, the Supreme Court’s writ jurisdiction is limited to matters involving Fundamental Rights and does not extend to other legal rights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 __
 
• This is incorrect because the Supreme Court’s writ jurisdiction under **Article 32** is restricted to the enforcement of **Fundamental Rights** only. It does not extend to other legal rights.
 
• However, High Courts under **Article 226** can issue writs for both Fundamental Rights and other legal rights.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: It is exclusive and cannot be exercised by the High Courts.**__
 __
 
• This is incorrect as **High Courts**, under **Article 226**, also have writ jurisdiction, which is broader than the Supreme Court’s jurisdiction under Article 32.
 
• The High Courts can issue writs for both Fundamental Rights and other legal rights.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: It allows the Court to issue writs only against the Central Government.**__
 
 
• This is incorrect as writs can be issued against both the **Central Government**, **State Governments**, and even private individuals or entities where applicable.

⇒ 180 = (1 ÷ 2) × 3 × d₂

⇒ 180 = 1.5 × d₂

**∴ The correct answer is 120 cm.**

Properties of a Rhombus
